behavioral_effects: Frontend browser checks now confirm what serves port 3000 and use the frontend-dev server on 3001 for working-tree changes, and drive portal UI through Playwright MCP
compatibility_impact: None - no interface, schema, or contract changes
limitations: Shrink pass ran in its inline form (documentation-only diff): nothing removed, because the file is a reviewed staged copy installed byte-for-byte so the review bookkeeping can match it; every added rule traces to an ACTIONED observation in the archived task-observer log
The skill's claims were checked against the repository: .claude/launch.json defines frontend-dev on port 3001
reason: The live frontend-feature skill had not changed since 2026-08-10, and its browser check verified the wrong thing in two ways: port 3000 is the compose container's production build with no bind mounts, so a fresh edit was simply absent and the check showed the old UI (observation 40), and Radix portal popovers dismissed between Browser-pane tool calls, so dropdown and dialog flows could not be driven or screenshotted (39). The 2026-08-30 review staged the fix; installing it points the check at the frontend-dev server on port 3001 and at Playwright MCP for portal UI.
rollback: git revert restores the previous skill text. The staged source copy stays outside the repository at ~/.claude/skill-updates/2026-08-30/frontend-feature and is not touched by a revert
security_impact: None - agent-facing skill text only; no runtime code, configuration, or permission changes
summary: Install the reviewed frontend-feature update: check the working tree on a dev server, not the baked compose image, and drive portal UI with Playwright
